description: Change a webhook endpoint: its url, events or description, or turn it off (active false) or back on (active true). Fields you omit keep their value; description null removes the description. A new url follows the rules of create_webhook_endpoint, keeps the same signing secret, and starts the endpoint's failure count afresh. active true turns an endpoint back on, whether PostFast turned it off (disabledReason GONE or FAILING) or a user did, and resets its failure count; it fails with webhook.limitReached when the workspace already has 5 active endpoints. Events that happen while an endpoint is off are never sent to it, not even after it is turned back on. An id that isn't in this workspace fails with webhook.notFound. Returns the updated endpoint.

active.description: false turns the endpoint off; true turns it back on and resets its failure count

description.description: New note (max 255 characters), or null to remove it

events.description: The event types to send from now on, replacing the current ones (the values create_webhook_endpoint takes)

url.description: New receiver URL, under the rules of create_webhook_endpoint

name: update_webhook_endpoint
title: Update Webhook Endpoint
